uzo.purpose: Names a status in one to three words next to what it describes: draft, in review, valid, 3 violations.

instead.kialo: A badge is read in passing, because a status is one glance; a sentence that explains is a notice (avizo).
A badge is no control, because a label that answers a click hides an action; an action is a butono, a destination a ligilo.
A bare number says nothing, because '3' without 'violations' is no status; a person decides what the number is.
A value in a range is a measure, not a status, because it has a scale; that is the mezurilo.

boundary.kialo: A badge in the brand colour says no status, because the brand colour is no state; a person decides what it marks.
A dot without text is colour alone, because a person who does not see the hue reads nothing (WCAG 1.4.1); the text is required.
A chip that can be removed is a filter, because removing acts; that is an Ero of its own.

containers.name: tabelo
containers.kialo: A status stands in the cell of its row, because the row is what it describes (tabelo, ④).

containers.name: atributlisto
containers.kialo: A status is the value of an attribute, because the key names what it says (atributlisto, ④).

containers.name: page-title
containers.kialo: A status stands next to the title of what it describes, because that is where a person looks first.

containers.name: navigado
containers.kialo: A count next to a navigation entry says how much waits there, because the entry is what it counts (navigado, ⑤).
